videos.title: A350 XWB 總裝程序概覽（官方動畫）
videos.titleEn: A350 XWB final assembly: a step-by-step overview (official animation)
videos.scope: Airbus 的總裝概念動畫，並非每一道現場作業的實拍或核准作業卡。
videos.scopeEn: Airbus final-assembly concept animation, not footage of every shop-floor operation or approved work instructions.
watchFor: 辨認預先裝備模組與總裝站的分工。
追蹤機身、翼與系統整合介面。
找出影片未展開的檢查與驗證活動。
watchForEn: Separate pre-equipped modules from final assembly stations.
Track fuselage, wing and system interfaces.
Identify inspections and verification not detailed in the animation.
videos.before: 列出你預期在總裝前已完成的子系統。
videos.beforeEn: List subsystems you expect to arrive already prepared.
videos.after: 畫出模組交接及品質證據的流向。
videos.afterEn: Draw module handoffs and the flow of quality evidence.
videos.playbackEvidence: Official Airbus channel metadata verified using public YouTube oEmbed; playback remains provider-dependent.

videos.title: Landsat 9：不只是一張影像
videos.titleEn: Landsat 9 - More Than Just A Picture
videos.scope: 官方任務解說，包含影像與視覺化；不等於卫星組裝紀錄或所有 Landsat 世代的相同規格。
videos.scopeEn: Official mission explanation with imagery and visualization; not an assembly record or a common specification for every Landsat generation.
watchFor: 區分影像的空間細節與輻射量測能力。
辨認長期觀測與感測器校準的關係。
將太空段、地面段與資料使用者連起來。
watchForEn: Distinguish spatial detail from radiometric measurement capability.
Connect long-term observations with sensor calibration.
Link space segment, ground segment and data users.
videos.before: 寫出一個需要多年可比較影像的問題。
videos.beforeEn: State a question that needs comparable observations across years.
videos.after: 說明為何漂亮的照片仍不足以證明科學量測品質。
videos.afterEn: Explain why an attractive image alone does not establish scientific measurement quality.
videos.playbackEvidence: Linked by NASA mission/SVS pages; NASA Goddard channel metadata verified using public oEmbed.

videos.title: ATLAS 與大型強子對撞機導覽
videos.titleEn: Introduction to ATLAS and the Large Hadron Collider
videos.scope: 官方公眾導覽；ATLAS 是 LHC 的實驗偵測器之一，影片並非加速器操作程序。可用音軌依原播放器設定。
videos.scopeEn: Official public introduction. ATLAS is one LHC experiment; this is not accelerator operating procedure. Available audio tracks depend on player settings.
watchFor: 區分粒子加速、碰撞、偵測與資料分析。
辨認偵測器層次如何提供不同證據。
觀察跨國團隊與資料流程的關係。
watchForEn: Separate acceleration, collision, detection and analysis.
Identify how detector layers provide different evidence.
Connect the international collaboration with data flows.
videos.before: 預畫一張束流與偵測器各司其職的系統圖。
videos.beforeEn: Sketch distinct beam and detector functions.
videos.after: 把一個粒子訊號追蹤到可供分析的紀錄。
videos.afterEn: Trace one detector signal into an analyzable record.
videos.playbackEvidence: Exact embed ID extracted from the official ATLAS introductory-video page; official channel verified with oEmbed.

videos.title: NEWater：從處理後用水到高純度再生水
videos.titleEn: NEWater: From Treated Used Water to Ultra-Clean Water
videos.scope: PUB 的再生水流程概述；不同工廠前處理配置可能不同，不作自行製備飲用水的配方。
videos.scopeEn: PUB overview of water reclamation. Pretreatment varies across facilities; this is not a recipe for producing drinking water independently.
watchFor: 辨認 MF／UF、逆滲透與紫外線的不同功能。
區分進水、產水與濃縮流。
把流程屏障與監測證據連結起來。
watchForEn: Distinguish MF/UF, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet functions.
Separate feed, product and concentrate streams.
Connect treatment barriers with monitoring evidence.
videos.before: 先列出三種不同的水質污染或量測指標。
videos.beforeEn: List three distinct water-quality contaminants or measurement indicators.
videos.after: 解釋為何單一膜元件不足以代表整套處理與品質保證系統。
videos.afterEn: Explain why one membrane is not the whole treatment and quality-assurance system.
videos.playbackEvidence: Exact embed ID obtained from PUB official NEWater page; sgPUB channel metadata verified using public oEmbed.
